title: Emma Clarke (ECLARKE)
summary: Emma Clarke is a purchase executive (PUR-EXEC) at Northbridge Cycles managing procurement for battery packs, frames, chargers, and packaging components.
body:
Emma Clarke (user ID ECLARKE) is an active purchase executive at Northbridge Cycles based in the Manchester office, reporting to [[user-dokafor|Daniel Okafor]][^r17][^r40]. She is assigned role [[role-pur-exec|PUR-EXEC]] under default cost centre [[cc-prd-05|PRD-05]] and holds an individual document approval threshold of £250,000 gross including VAT[^r17][^r18]. As of 26 October 2026, she is responsible for procuring core components and packaging materials across production cost centres, including the upcoming [[cc-prd-07|PRD-07]] spring launch run[^r1][^r38][^r48].

## Role and responsibilities

In Ledgerline, Emma Clarke operates as purchase executive for operating unit NBC-MAN-01 with a document approval limit of £250,000 gross[^r17][^r18]. Under [[pol-apr-002|POL-APR-002]], any commitment exceeding £250,000 gross escalates to higher management, including [[user-dokafor|Daniel Okafor]] or [[user-hweber|Henrik Weber]][^r18][^r19][^r48]. When planning battery purchases for the launch run, she noted that ordering 2,000 [[items-bat|BAT-500]] units at £119.00 would exceed her £250,000 limit and mandate sign-off by Daniel Okafor[^r48].

She serves as buyer across component families such as frames, braking, accessories, and packaging items, including [[items-mnt|MNT-FRM-01]], [[items-bel|BEL-STD-01]], [[items-brk|BRK-PAD-01]], and [[items-box|BOX-BIKE-01]][^r1]. In her day-to-day work from the Manchester office, she monitors frame replenishment orders, drive assemblies, and parts requisitions originating from the Leeds workshop, arranging peer cover with [[user-kmensah|Kwame Mensah]] during leave periods[^r40][^r41].

## Purchasing operations

Across 2026, Clarke raised standard purchase orders across multiple cost centres, including regular assembly lines and project runs:
* **Batteries and chargers:** Placed initial charger order PO/2026/00030 on 12 January 2026 for 120,000 units of [[items-chg|CHG-4A-01]] (£13,464,000.00 gross) against [[cc-prd-05|PRD-05]][^r20]. Issued battery pack order PO/2026/01044 for £246,240.00 to [[sup-vc-ein-0042|Voltway Cells]] on 3 August 2026, followed by PO/2026/01120 for [[items-bat|BAT-500]] (£246,240.00) in September 2026[^r30][^r31]. On 23 October 2026, she raised PO/2026/01179 for 4,000 units of [[items-chg|CHG-4A-01]] (£460,800.00) under [[cc-prd-07|PRD-07]], which entered pending approval (PA) status awaiting release by Daniel Okafor on 26 October 2026[^r33][^r47].
* **Frames:** Raised high-value frame orders including PO/2026/00129 to Swale Frameworks Ltd on 2 February 2026, PO/2026/00753 for £5,542,020.00 gross to Ure Frameworks Ltd on June 2026, and PO/2026/01033 for 11,200 units of FRM-ROC-XL-RED (£2,384,390.40 gross; £1,986,992 basic) on 3 August 2026 approved by Henrik Weber[^r19][^r21][^r25][^r29]. In September 2026, she issued frame orders PO/2026/01102 (£174,547.20) and PO/2026/01106 (£560,188.80) for [[items-frm|FRM-*]] lines[^r31].
* **Brakes and controls:** Issued PO/2026/00284 on 3 March 2026 for 27,000 units of BRK-ROT-160 (£1,621,296.00 gross) against [[cc-prd-04|PRD-04]], and placed PO/2026/00290 for 9,000 units of DSP-03 on 4 March 2026, which recorded a rejected status (RJ)[^r22][^r23]. On 28 July 2026, she placed PO/2026/01013 for 13,500 units of BRK-ROT-180 (£557,280.00 gross) against [[cc-prd-05|PRD-05]][^r28].
* **Packaging and accessories:** Raised accessory order PO/2026/00715 on May 2026 for 52,500 units of [[items-bel|BEL-STD-01]] (£428,400.00)[^r24]. On 27 July 2026, she issued PO/2026/01009 for 27,000 units of PKG-FOAM-01 (£172,044.00 gross) against [[cc-log-01|LOG-01]][^r27]. On 9 October 2026, she placed order PO/2026/01167 for 40,000 units of [[items-box|BOX-BIKE-01]] (£1,032,000.00) under [[cc-prd-07|PRD-07]][^r32].
* **Maintenance cancellations:** Entered cancelled purchase orders PO/2026/01002 (MRO-00451) and PO/2026/01008 (MRO-00860) on 27 July 2026 for cost centre [[cc-mnt-01|MNT-01]], flagged with status CN[^r26].

In project planning, Clarke was assigned during the week of 19 October 2026 to raise the purchase requisition for launch run battery packs against [[cc-prd-07|PRD-07]][^r38]. On 22 October 2026, she received quotation Q-BE-26-0917 from Julien Marchand of Brightcell Energy for 36 V 500 Wh packs compatible with [[items-bat|BAT-500]], and consulted [[user-lmoreno|Luis Moreno]] on 23 October 2026 regarding whether Northbridge could switch volume away from Voltway Cells[^r45][^r46]. On 26 October 2026, she reported that the Ledgerline requisition fetch function defaulted to the prior baseline rate of £114.00 (£273,600 estimate) rather than the £119.00 contract price[^r48][^r49].

## Expediting, master data, and meetings

Clarke liaises across operations to resolve packaging and delivery bottlenecks. On 6 March 2019, she was instructed to update system packaging records for receiving and packing benches for revised retail boxed accessories[^r39]. On 2 September 2025, she requested bike build totals from [[user-lmoreno|Luis Moreno]] to construct an indicative carton forecast, observing that Ledgerline only stores firm orders rather than forward packaging projections[^r42][^r43]. On 23 July 2026, she expedited a partial delivery of brake pads, securing an overnight run for the balance, briefing production, and instructing stores to withhold invoice settlement pending physical verification[^r44].

She acts as a registered uploader for supplier quality records in [[data-supplier-master|SUPPLIER_MASTER]], recording ISO-9001 compliance certificates across multiple vendors:
* CPC-LEE-0938 (certificate ISO9001/88245 on 1 June 2023)[^r2]
* AF-ARN-1097 (certificate ISO9001/67841 on 1 February 2023)[^r12]
* AES-ROT-1142 (certificate ISO9001/91481 on 1 March 2023)[^r16]
* SMS-BRA-0989 (certificate ISO9001/81457 on 1 September 2023)[^r5]
* SES-SAL-1011 (certificate ISO9001/41555 on 1 March 2024)[^r7]
* MF-SUN-1125 (certificate ISO9001/92344 on 1 March 2024)[^r15]
* NBN-SUN-0953 (certificate ISO9001/60150 on 1 July 2024)[^r4]
* SMS-NOT-1038 (certificate ISO9001/27945 on 1 September 2024)[^r8]
* OBN-ODE-1107 (certificate ISO9001/61325 on 1 November 2024)[^r13]
* DTC-CAR-1118 (certificate ISO9001/86705 on 1 February 2025)[^r14]
* RC-TEL-0995 (certificate ISO9001/63985 on 1 March 2025)[^r6]
* FF-LEE-1048 (certificate ISO9001/99174 on 1 May 2025)[^r9]
* SBS-STU-1077 (certificate ISO9001/63474 on 1 June 2025)[^r11]
* PL-KAT-0951 (certificate ISO9001/31313 on 1 July 2025)[^r3]
* BC-BRA-1054 (certificate ISO9001/36530 on 1 November 2025)[^r10]

Clarke regularly represents purchasing at operational catch-ups. She attended production planning meetings on 3 March 2022 and 2 March 2023, where she reviewed sea shipment notices for battery packs and requested that production retain warranty returns for test rigs[^r34][^r35]. She attended the Leeds unit update meeting on 8 May 2024 as document owner, and joined the finance and purchasing catch-up on 12 December 2025 addressing unmatched receipts, pro-forma documents, and supplier credit holds[^r36][^r37].
